mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_name, t.task_bean, t.task_params, t.task_cron, t.task_status, t.remark, t.update_time, t.create_time, t.task_type, t.exe_path, t.datasource_id, ds.name AS datasource_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'DATA' ) AS depend_id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'DATA' ) AS data_depend_id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'CONTROL' ) AS control_depend_id, t.period, t.task_system, t.theme, t.offset, t.job_key, t.notification_failed, t.notification_completed

SELECT
FROM t_quartz_task t LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id order by t.id desc

FROM t_quartz_task t LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id WHERE t.task_status = 0 ORDER BY t.id
